pdfredact.drop: Drop the PDF you want to redact, or click to choose one
pdfredact.label.drag: Drag over what to hide — you can move between pages as you go
pdfredact.status.idle: The file stays in your browser — nothing is uploaded anywhere.
pdfredact.err.engine: Could not load the PDF engine.
pdfredact.err.open: Could not open the PDF (it may be password protected).
pdfredact.say.ready: Drag over what to hide. When you download, the text on that page is gone entirely.
pdfredact.err.tooSmall: That was too small, so it was skipped. Drag a rectangle over the area.
pdfredact.err.maker: Could not load the PDF writer
pdfredact.say.done: {pages} pages · {size}. Not just the covered spots — the text data itself is gone, so copying reveals nothing.
pdfredact.err.generic: Could not build the redacted PDF.
pdfredact.warn: Drawing a black box on a PDF leaves the text inside the file — copy it and everything comes out. This tool re-renders the pages as images, so the text itself is gone.
